databaseInUse: database is open in another process; close it to change the schema
schemaTooNew: database schema is newer than this binary
legacyNodeDatabase: database was created by the legacy Node runtime and is not supported
unknownModel: model is not in the provider catalog
modelWithoutToolCalls: model does not support tool calling
invalidEffort: effort must be one of none, low, medium, high, max
conflict: config file changed since it was read
runHeld: run is active in another process or engine
